title: Build 'Change Capsule' — tiered changelog template + stakeholder review cadence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'Change Capsule' deliverable that bundles a tiered customer-facing changelog slice, an internal exec summary, and a stakeholder signoff matrix. Purpose is to speed cross-team review, reduce last-minute redaction risk, and provide pre-baked audience summaries for Sales/Support/Legal/DevRel.
acceptance_criteria: Change Capsule template exists in Confluence with slots for: TL;DR, Audience Impact, Rollout Window, Migration Guidance, Known Issues, Revert Plan, PR links, and Redaction flags
Two sample capsules produced for runtime-1.22 and console-2026.03 and approved by Eng Lead + Legal + Support
Signoff matrix workflow created in Linear automation (assign reviewers, 48-hour grace for edits, auto-escalate after 24h) and tested end-to-end
Localization ready copy guidelines documented and localization request flow created (source-of-truth string keys for L10n)
timeline: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with ENG/Design/Legal/Support/Marketing — agree on capsule sections and SLAs
2026-03-03: Draft template in Confluence and share with stakeholder panel for feedback
2026-03-08: Incorporate feedback; mock two sample capsules using real PRs and metrics
2026-03-12: Dry run: send capsule through signoff matrix; measure bottlenecks and update automation rules
2026-03-20: Target deploy of capsule process for runtime-1.22 patch release
progress_updates: 2026-03-02 — Kickoff notes: consensus on 3-tier audience model (devs, integrators, end-customer admins). Legal emphasized early disclosure windows for breaking changes.
2026-03-05 — Design provided two compact layout options; team chose card-based capsule for quick skimming. Action: Design to export accessible HTML widget for Support docs.
2026-03-09 — Automation: Linear webhook prototype routes capsule draft to reviewers; observed delays from Marketing when no context provided. Added automatic context pull (PR summary + perf delta).

2026-03-12 — Dry run completed. Bottleneck: localization requests were submitted too late; added L10n cutoff (T-72h) and tagging convention to capsule header. Legal flagged one wording around data residency — updated redaction checklist.
blockers: Localization team head out on leave 2026-03-13 to 2026-03-17 — backup contact required
Console release manager needs final SLA numbers for latency change messaging before we can finalize customer-impact section
notes: Design note: Capsule should be copy-first and single-column for mobile readability; desktop can show extended metrics section behind a toggle.
Operational note: Add a one-click 'Ops handback' export that generates an incident-ready runbook with rollback commands and owner contacts for SRE.
Reviewer guidance: When you review, annotate recommended redactions inline and set urgency flag (normal/urgent/blocker). The automation will translate flags into escalation steps.
